description: CAPABILITY CLASS -> CONCRETE MODEL, per provider. A capability class says how much reasoning a task needs; a provider entry says which model currently satisfies it there. Compatibility shims (routing/shims.json) are a separate dimension keyed on the model family, and the composite `model@preset/slug` string is derived at runtime by tools/fabric/routing.py — it is never written here.

code-low.title: Inexpensive, mechanical delegated coding work
code-low.description: Simple repository exploration, routine modifications, test generation, documentation updates, lint fixes, and other low-risk tasks.

code-medium.title: Default delegated coding worker
code-medium.description: Normal engineering work that needs solid reasoning but is not unusually difficult or high-consequence.

code-high.title: Difficult or high-consequence engineering work
code-high.description: Architecture, difficult debugging, security review, subtle refactoring, concurrency, protocol design, and important cross-component reasoning.

review.title: The review class
review.description: The adversarial substitute reviewer. Not a coding class: a review's failure mode is a green PR that merges, so its model is gated by routing/policies/review-grade.json and is never a cost decision.

anthropic.description: Plain `claude`, Anthropic by construction. Values are harness tier aliases (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) the harness binds to its current Claude model of that tier; the Agent tool accepts nothing else. The review class rides `fable`, the alias no coding class uses, so that on the broker path it never shares code-high's export. No shim applies to a native Claude model.

openrouter.description: The broker path (runtime/openrouter/launch via the ori CLI). Values are OpenRouter model ids; the launcher derives the composite with the family shim and exports it under the harness alias the class maps to (runtime/claude-code/aliases.json). The review class is exported under the fable alias and gated by routing/policies/review-grade.json.
